decimals().details: `_VIRTUAL_SHARES` is `10 ** 3`, which effectively makes shares 1000x more granular      than the underlying. Reporting the extra three decimals keeps "one whole share is      worth about one whole asset" true, so `pricePerShare()` and the high-water mark      stay readable. Leaving `decimals()` at 18 would not be a security bug, but every      share balance would display 1000x larger than the value it represents.

params.assets: Amount of underlying to pull from the caller.

returns.feeShares: Shares minted as the fee (zero if there is no new peak).

params.owner: Address whose shares would be burned.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

returns._0: Assets that would be paid out.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Skips emitting an {Approval} event indicating an allowance update. This is not required by the ERC. See {xref-ERC20-_approve-address-address-uint256-bool-}[_approve]. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

params.assets: Amount of underlying to send out.

asset().notice: Underlying asset held by the vault.

convertToAssets(uint256).notice: Converts shares to assets, rounding down.

convertToShares(uint256).notice: Converts assets to shares, rounding down.

harvest().notice: Charges the 20% performance fee on profit above the all-time peak price         per share, minting the fee to `feeRecipient`.

highWaterMark().notice: Highest price per share ever recorded, scaled by `_PRICE_SCALE`.

maxWithdraw(address).notice: Largest asset amount `owner` can withdraw right now.

previewRedeem(uint256).notice: Assets that redeeming `shares` would return, rounded down.

previewWithdraw(uint256).notice: Shares that would be burned to withdraw `assets`, rounded up.

pricePerShare().notice: Current price of one whole share in asset units, scaled by 1e18.

redeem(uint256,address,address).notice: Burns exactly `shares` from `owner` and sends the assets to `receiver`.

totalAssets().notice: Total underlying held by the vault.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).notice: Burns shares from `owner` and sends exactly `assets` to `receiver`.
